plugins.description: Evidence-grounded dental research and clinical decision-support system for Claude Code. v1.2 adds the Evidence Intelligence Engine: retrieval, citation verification, quality appraisal, certainty, synthesis and clinical applicability are six separate assessments, so a bibliographically VERIFIED citation is never treated as strong evidence on that basis alone. Citation Verification 2.0 (seven states, including VERIFIED_WITH_METADATA_DISCREPANCY), conservative structured certainty assessment, evidence directness, an executable numeric evidence gate, retraction/correction gating, conflicting-evidence handling, cohort overlap detection, a standardized evidence table and a Clinical Bottom Line. Research retrieval runs over the hosted Dental AI Research Remote MCP server with plugin-local connector fallback. Connected sources: PubMed/NCBI, Crossref (metadata and citation verification), ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (registry records only). Cochrane/CENTRAL, Embase and Scopus are NOT integrated. Full text is not retrieved. Saudi-aware governance with an SFDA regulatory gate (NOT CONNECTED — authentication required).
